title: chrysanthemum gossypinum
intro: Chrysanthemum gossypinum, commonly known as Velvet Chrysanthemum or Velvet Mum, is a plant species known for its ornamental and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. Chrysanthemum gossypinum is used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anti-anxiety, and anti-spasmodic effects, which can aid in relieving symptoms of insomnia, anxiety disorders, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum gossypinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for natural remedies.
